title: Anchors outside scope of Appendix D.
officialText:
The strength design of anchors that are not within the scope of Appendix D of
ACI 318, as modified by this code, shall be in accordance with a procedure subject to the approval of the commissioner.
SECTION BC 1913
SHOTCRETE
